description: Noise floor and crystal-form controls for the Cas3 hinge measurement, with the nucleotide-state series plotted against the Cascade-recruited state
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import defaultdict
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research/1.0"})
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
NUCS={'ADP','ATP','ANP','AGS','ACP','DTP'}
def parse(t):
    L=t.splitlines(); i=0; cols=[]; rows=[]; n=len(L)
    while i<n:
        if L[i].startswith('_atom_site.'):
            while i<n and L[i].startswith('_atom_site.'): cols.append(L[i].strip().split('.')[1]); i+=1
            while i<n:
                ln=L[i]
                if ln.startswith('#') or ln.startswith('loop_') or ln.startswith('_') or ln.strip()=='': break
                rows.append(ln.split()); i+=1
            break
        i+=1
    return {c:k for k,c in enumerate(cols)},[r for r in rows if len(r)==len(cols)]
def cell_of(t):
    out={}
    for ln in t.splitlines():
        for k in ['_cell.length_a','_cell.length_b','_cell.length_c','_cell.angle_beta',
                  '_symmetry.space_group_name_H-M']:
            if ln.startswith(k+' ') or ln.startswith(k+'  '):
                out[k.split('.')[-1]]=ln[len(k):].strip().strip("'")
    return out
def ca_chains(idx,rows):
    out=defaultdict(dict); het=defaultdict(list)
    g,an,cn,ch,sn=idx['group_PDB'],idx['label_atom_id'],idx['auth_comp_id'],idx['auth_asym_id'],idx['auth_seq_id']
    x,y,z=idx['Cartn_x'],idx['Cartn_y'],idx['Cartn_z']; mdl=idx.get('pdbx_PDB_model_num')
    for r in rows:
        if mdl is not None and r[mdl] not in ('1','.'): continue
        p=np.array([float(r[x]),float(r[y]),float(r[z])])
        if r[g]=='HETATM' and r[cn] in NUCS: het[r[ch]].append((r[cn],p)); continue
        if r[cn] in AA3 and r[an]=='CA':
            try: out[r[ch]][int(r[sn])]=(AA3[r[cn]],p)
            except: pass
    return out,het
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0); qc=Q.mean(0)
    V,s,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc)); dd=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))
    R=V@np.diag([1,1,dd])@Wt
    return R,np.sqrt((((P-pc)@R-(Q-qc))**2).sum(1).mean())
def ang(R): return np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip((np.trace(R)-1)/2,-1,1)))
A1=(250,470); A2=(471,700)

raw={}
for pid in ["4QQW","4QQY","4QQZ","4QQX","6C66"]:
    t=S.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.cif",timeout=300).text
    idx,rows=parse(t); ch,het=ca_chains(idx,rows); raw[pid]=(ch,het,cell_of(t))
print("crystal form check (are the nucleotide-state structures isomorphous?)")
for pid in ["4QQW","4QQY","4QQZ","4QQX"]:
    print(" ",pid,raw[pid][2])

ref=raw["4QQY"][0]["C"]
def hinge(d):
    Rs={}
    for nm,(a,b) in [("A1",A1),("A2",A2)]:
        com=[i for i in sorted(set(d)&set(ref)) if a<=i<=b]
        R,rms=kabsch(np.array([d[i][1] for i in com]),np.array([ref[i][1] for i in com]))
        Rs[nm]=(R,len(com),rms)
    c1=np.array([d[i][1] for i in d if A1[0]<=i<=A1[1]]).mean(0)
    c2=np.array([d[i][1] for i in d if A2[0]<=i<=A2[1]]).mean(0)
    return ang(Rs["A2"][0]@Rs["A1"][0].T), np.linalg.norm(c1-c2), Rs["A1"][1], Rs["A1"][2], Rs["A2"][2]

print("\nnoise floor: the four independent copies in each asymmetric unit")
noise=[]
for pid,lab in [("4QQW","apo"),("4QQY","ADP"),("4QQZ","AMPPNP"),("4QQX","ATP")]:
    for c in sorted(raw[pid][0]):
        d=raw[pid][0][c]
        if len(set(d)&set(ref))<600: continue
        h,cl,n,r1,r2=hinge(d); noise.append((pid,lab,c,h,cl))
        print(f"  {pid} {lab:7} chain {c}: hinge {h:5.2f} deg  cleft {cl:6.2f} A  (lobe rmsd {r1:.2f}/{r2:.2f})")
nz=np.array([x[3] for x in noise]); cz=np.array([x[4] for x in noise])
print(f"\n  all-copy spread: hinge {nz.min():.2f}-{nz.max():.2f} deg (sd {nz.std():.2f}), cleft {cz.min():.2f}-{cz.max():.2f} A (sd {cz.std():.2f})")
h6,cl6,n6,r1,r2=hinge(raw["6C66"][0]["G"])
print(f"  6C66 Cascade-recruited Cas3: hinge {h6:.2f} deg, cleft {cl6:.2f} A, lobe rmsd {r1:.2f}/{r2:.2f}, n={n6}")
print(f"  z-score of recruited state against the nucleotide-state spread: hinge {(h6-nz.mean())/nz.std():.1f}, cleft {(cl6-cz.mean())/cz.std():.1f}")

# figure
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.2))
labs=[f"{p}\n{l} (chain {c})" for p,l,c,_,_ in noise]+["6C66\nrecruited (G)"]
hv=list(nz)+[h6]; cv=list(cz)+[cl6]
cols=['#4477aa']*len(nz)+['#cc3311']
axes[0].bar(range(len(hv)),hv,color=cols)
axes[0].set_ylabel("hinge rotation vs ADP reference (degrees)")
axes[0].set_title("RecA1 to RecA2 hinge, T. fusca Cas3")
axes[1].bar(range(len(cv)),cv,color=cols); axes[1].set_ylim(20,26)
axes[1].set_ylabel("RecA1 to RecA2 centroid distance (A)")
axes[1].set_title("Interlobe cleft width")
for ax in axes:
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(hv)))
    ax.set_xticklabels([f"{p} {l} {c}" for p,l,c,_,_ in noise]+["6C66 recruited G"],rotation=90,fontsize=7)
fig.suptitle("Nucleotide state does not move the Cas3 RecA lobes; blue = apo/ADP/AMPPNP/ATP copies, red = Cascade-recruited",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
